message.content: I don’t have real‑time data, but you can check the latest air quality index (AQI) for Los Angeles on sites like the EPA’s AirNow portal, the World Air Quality Index project, or local news outlets. Typically, LA’s AQI varies from “Good” (0–50) to “Unhealthy” (151–200) depending on traffic, weather, and wildfire smoke. If you’re planning outdoor activities, it’s best to look up the current AQI and any health advisories.
